svg.title: Reading a point on the Smith chart
svg.desc: A Smith chart with the short circuit at the left edge, the open at the right edge and the match at the centre. The load 25 + j25 ohms (z = 0.5 + j0.5) sits where the r = 0.5 circle meets the x = +0.5 arc, at Gamma = 0.447 at 117 degrees. Adding an eighth of a wavelength of 50 ohm line rotates it 90 degrees clockwise on the constant-VSWR circle to z = 2 + j1, which is 100 + j50 ohms.
svg.text: Reading a point: ZL = 25 + j25 Ω on a 50 Ω chart, then λ/8 of line toward the generator
z = Z/Z₀ = 0.5 + j0.5: find the r = 0.5 circle (blue)
and the x = +0.5 arc (orange). They cross here.
Line length only spins Γ around the centre:
Land on z = 2 + j1, i.e. 100 + j50 Ω.
